Collective Curriculum Roadmap

Master the lineage and science of master formulation. See how your learning path unfolds.

I

Module 1: Botanical Foundations

UNLOCKED (Free Week)

Morphology, plant energetics, naming taxonomies, and field identification of over 80 medicinal plant species. Set your foundational lineage-based learning path.

II

Module 2: Extraction Chemistry & Solvents

Requires Purchase

Menstruum calculations, alcohol solubility thresholds, oil infusions, double-extraction decoctions, and standardization parameters for maximum bioavailability.

III

Module 3: Formulation Architecture & Ratio Math

Requires Purchase

Calculating precise ratios, synergizing herbal actions (drivers, helpers, messengers), formulation templates, and organoleptic testing procedures.

IV

Module 4: Adaptogens & Circadian Dosing

Requires Purchase

Deep-dive into the HPA axis, endocrine wellness loops, adaptogenic profiles, and crafting personalized circadian tonic schedules.

V

Module 5: Compliance, Marketing & Business

Requires Purchase

Navigating FDA DSHEA compliance, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), labeling requirements, batch testing, and ethical formulation commerce.
